points.title: Why automatic formatting
points.must: Long, multi-author documents: styles, fields, captions and automatic notes keep them consistent and self-updating — compared with manual formatting.

points.title: Section break
points.must: Divides a document into sections, each with its own headers/footers, page numbering, margins and orientation; next page vs continuous; differs from a page break.

points.title: Fields
points.must: Automatic codes that update: PAGE, NUMPAGES, DATE, FILENAME, STYLEREF — with 'Page 7 of 38' as an example.

points.title: Header and footer options
points.must: Different first page, different odd & even pages, Link to previous, page-number format and Start at — each with its use.

points.title: Giving a chapter its own header
points.must: Steps: section break (next page) → switch off Link to Previous → new header / STYLEREF → restart numbering.

points.title: Worked example of sections
points.must: Title page without header, contents numbered i, ii, iii, chapters restart at 1, a landscape section for a wide diagram.

points.title: Footnote, endnote and separator
points.must: Footnote at the bottom of the page, endnote at the end of the document/section, both numbered automatically; the note separator line.

points.title: Footnote formatting options
points.must: Location, number format, custom mark, start at, restart each section/page, convert footnotes ↔ endnotes.

points.title: Footnote Text style
points.must: Format all notes at once by modifying the style; use different number formats for footnotes and endnotes.

points.title: Header row and table formatting tools
points.must: Repeat header rows, no row breaking across pages, merge/split, table styles, borders and shading, alignment, AutoFit, sort.

points.title: Caption and cross-reference
points.must: Caption = automatically numbered label (above a table); cross-reference = field that updates 'see Table 3'.

points.title: Wide and long tables
points.must: Landscape section for a wide table; repeated header and unbroken rows for a long one.

points.title: Common mistakes
points.must: At least three: Link to Previous left on; page break instead of section break; typed page numbers/notes/table numbers; merged cells in a sorted table.
